generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent twelve-frame full-body game sprite animation sheet, Xiao I / Lemniscatic horizontal spear dash, usable on ground OR in air.
Create a NEW exact 4 columns by3 rows sheet,12 consecutive distinct poses in reading order. Same young adult male Xiao identity, adult slim-athletic proportions, pale sleeveless torso outfit, dark teal tousled hair, teal tattoo, purple loose pants, black/gold boots, flowing teal/lavender cloth and ornate GREEN jade spear with thin dark shaft and gold end cap as reference images. Match the exquisite detailed Japanese fantasy anime painted sprite rendering. Use references for exact character/clothing/weapon identity only. DO NOT copy the old almost-identical crouching poses. Right-facing mild3/4 side view throughout. Same physical character scale and SAME full spear length through all frames.
The animation MUST visibly change from upright small-footwork anticipation to wound-up compression, to an explosive airborne horizontal spear-led dash, to lowering knees/feet and retracting the spear. It must not be twelve crouching figures merely aiming a spear.
TOP ROW,4 anticipation frames:
01: fairly upright ready posture, small staggered step, knees only softly bent, long spear held horizontally close across lower abdomen, elbows compact.
02: rotate torso slightly backward and draw the rear hand toward BACK HIP, slide entire spear backward; front elbow bends clearly, spear point still faces right but has retracted toward body. Weight begins loading rear leg.
03: deepest compact knee compression, rear hand pulled beside rear hip, elbows tucked in, chest winding, spear nearly parallel to abdomen, front foot light.
04: start forward lean from wound body, rear heel preparing push, both hands poised along shaft, head fixes target right; spear still visibly chambered compared to release.
MIDDLE ROW,2 contact and2 follow-through:
05 FIRST CONTACT: rear hand forcefully pushes shaft and front hand guides, spear tip ALREADY extended far to RIGHT at chest height, body bursts forward, BOTH feet leave the ground, torso angled forward, one knee forward and rear leg kicking back. Readable horizontal attack commitment immediately.
06: longest horizontal dash silhouette, chest extended forward and face tracking spear, rear leg stretches behind and front leg bends, full weapon almost horizontal to right, hands extend farther than windup, cloth streams left.
07: gather legs into a more compact AIRBORNE dash, front knee slightly under belly, back knee bends, weapon forward line stays stable; arms soften subtly, not same pose as06.
08: continue compact horizontal flight, swap the leg balance subtly, shoulders begin easing, spear still points straight forward; torso rises slightly compared to07.
BOTTOM ROW:
09: begin braking/recovery, BOTH legs lower below hips, torso rises visibly toward upright, knees preparing to absorb, spear still extended but elbows start bending.
10: front leg bends strongly downward as if about to land or settling in mid-air; rear knee comes under body, pelvis and chest re-center. A clear transition from long horizontal dash to compact upright recovery. NO actual ground or landing effect.
11: retract shaft to chest/abdomen by pulling hands BACK, elbows visibly bent near ribs, spearhead noticeably closer to body than05–09. Torso nearly upright, feet settling into modest stagger.
12: relaxed ready guard, body upright, small staggered feet, spear across abdomen with tip slightly up-right, flowing cloth settled. Similar ready height to01.
Only12 complete fighters, no additional effects or objects. No wind blade, NO circular aura, NO wind streaks, NO motion blur, NO duplicates/ghosts, NO ground plane or ground shadow, no floor dust. Wind projectile upgrades are rendered separately by engine so none here. Do not depict Xiao's plunge/downward spear skill; all action points right.
LAYOUT: landscape4:3 ideally1448x1086. Use modest figure size, standing body height about210px to leave room for the full spear. All head, shoes, cloth, gold rear cap, entire shaft and exact jade spear tip must fit inside separate disjoint silhouettes, generous at least30px transparent space between any neighboring fighter+weapon and24px at outer sheet edges. Preserve full adult body proportions. No text, labels, grid, frame numbers, border or watermark. Native RGBA true transparent alpha background.

registration.source: Read-only native RGBA inspection. Adaptive per-pose search regions; measure alpha>8 bounds then add12px crop padding. No raster modification, resizing, recoloring, compositing, re-encoding or PNG overwrite. Low-alpha generator fringe remains intact in source PNG.
registration.standingBodyHeightMethod: Anatomical standing-equivalent estimate from skull/chin, shoulder/hip and bent leg segment lengths, compared with existing locomotion identity. Excludes sword, lifted hands, ponytail and long cloth extrema; never derived directly from alpha bounding-box height.
registration.footAnchorMethod: Manual anatomical support reference between visible soles in planted frames, independent of blade/cloth bounding-box midpoint. Xiao airborne dash05-08 uses pelvis-projected reference x and common virtual sole plane y674 so tucked legs stay above the origin; bottom crops include transparent space for this anchor.
